hook_text: One grew on a river, one on gold, one at a port, one at a railway stop. Can you match them?
clip_script: OR Tambo International Airport. The departures board flashes: Cairo, Lagos, Nairobi. Cairo grew on the River Nile, with the pyramids at its door. Lagos grew as a busy port on the Atlantic, Nigeria's biggest city. Johannesburg grew after gold was found in 1886: eGoli, the place of gold. And Nairobi began as a railway stop in 1899, and now lions live next to its skyscrapers. Cities grow where there is a reason.
visual_style: Whiteboard departures board flipping to each city, then a map of Africa with each city marked by a dot and a small picture.
mood: Busy and exciting, like an airport full of journeys.
pacing: One city per beat, each with one picture and one reason.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and mark all four cities on your own map of Africa.
